ValidationRule.description: All Profiles, except “Tanium Partner Portal Admin”, should NOT be able to create a record if in the field of “Partner Role”, the value of “Influencer” is selected. Sales System ID-0050e000005czlJAAQ
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
NOT( $Permission.DisableValidationRules ) && Opportunity__r.RecordType.Name != 'Ramp' && ( NOT( $Profile.Name = 'Tanium Partner Portal Admin')&& ISNEW() && ISPICKVAL(Partner_Role__c, 'Influencer') )
&& ( NOT( CreatedBy.X18D_ID__c = "0050e000005czlJAAQ") && ISNEW() && ISPICKVAL(Partner_Role__c, 'Influencer') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please submit an Influence Partner Registration ISR in order to add this Influencer. Contact ChannelOps@tanium.com for any questions.
